text:
ria_pm: Tiny sprint for the June webinar: need a compact "benchmark snapshot" pack for paid/social + press kit.

ria_pm: Deliverables: 1) hero (1600x600) + email hero (1200x628) static, 2) 1-slide benchmark graphic (1920x1080) + a 1-panel social-ready crop, 3) 4 social thumbnails (square x2, story loop x1, linkedin banner) and 4) a small SVG explainer of routing+cache. Locales: EN/FR/DE. Deadline: EOD Tuesday.

sam_design: OK. GIF or MP4 for story? file size cap?

ria_pm: MP4 for story, keep <1.5MB. Social thumbs should be WebP. Keep copy editable.

jo_copy: Headlines: "Production-ready inference, predictable costs" + alt "Ship LLM features with confidence". Subhead "June 12 webinar: demo + benchmark". CTA "Register" / "Save my seat". I'll drop FR/DE variants by tomorrow 9am PT.

sam_design: For the benchmark: three plotted points (Hosted, Dedicated, Private) with a translucent overlay showing "after caching/routing". Axes labeled: latency (ms) and cost ($/1k tokens). Use teal + warm orange; avoid alarm red.

mei_i18n: Please put each string in its own text layer and add a CSV-ready page in Figma. Avoid idioms.

alex_legal: No competitor logos. If we include customer quotes/logos, attach approvals. Any hard % claims need a source. I can review final assets within 3 hours.

figma-bot: File created: Jun12-BenchSnapshot-Pack. Frames: hero-1600x600, hero-email-1200x628, slide-1920x1080, social-crop-1200x628, social-square-1080x1080(2), story-1080x1920, linkedin-1200x627, svg-diagram. Link: https://figma.com/file/benchsnapshot (placeholder).

sam_design: I'll push initial comps by tomorrow 11am PT. Prioritize slide + hero. Flagging any blockers here.

ria_pm: Thanks — priority order: 1) slide, 2) landing hero, 3) social. Ping legal when ready for quick brand check. :thumbsup:
